description: TRON (uno_simple_ds_v3) on the rc300 reduced run with vit_rc300_v1's split. TRON's recipe: 2 detached unrolled steps, lr 1e-3 (50-epoch warmup from 1e-5, then halved after 15 epochs without improvement), up to 500 epochs, fp32, physics phase-in 50 + 100 epochs, early stopping after 50 epochs without improvement from epoch 150. Loss: TRON's mass shells; guard 7.0 and div B vs the truth's, as for the ViT.

provenance.known_prior_data_exposure: Historical checkpoint trained/selected on Kevin 80/10/10 data, overlapping the frozen benchmark. Existing best_blind evaluation artifacts; no blind claim.
